name: br-state-tax-profiles
description: Apply Brazil's state-level ICMS parameters for calendar 2026 after the national indirect-tax classification. Covers all states and the Federal District with ordinary internal-rate clauses, poverty-fund conditions, destination differential and substitution-tax boundaries, credit controls and local filing/payment routes. Distinguishes the Alagoas midyear change and the two Mato Grosso DIFAL bases. States exactly which current product lists, original acts, local returns and payment calendars remain incomplete. Also routes state inheritance/donation and vehicle-tax questions without inventing a national rate or deadline.
